title: What's Working
summary: Check every Threads post you published this year against your own median views, show which kinds Threads is killing and the one kind it still pushes hardest, then have Threadify write three posts in that pattern with editable review and optional Auto Plugs and schedule them only after one exact approval.
triggers: why did my threads views drop
which of my posts does threads push

inputs.name: connected account, this year's post performance, owner edits and optional saved offer

outputs.name: alive/dead diagnosis against your median, #1 pattern, local report page, approval packet and schedule receipt

free_capabilities: deterministic diagnosis script that labels every post dead, stuck or alive against the account's own median
month-by-month median views and alive share
pattern ranking by median multiple from the agent's labels, small samples flagged
self-contained local report page charting every post against the median
local casing guard that proves lower(original) == lower(final) for every post and plug
local review checker for owner edit authorization, packet hashes and exact readback
three local editable post blocks, optional Auto Plug choice and a Done editing receipt that never approves scheduling
preserved original and owner-final copies with local change comparisons
paid_capability_stubs: post performance history depends on the plan's analytics window
Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug

must_show: Auto Plugs off or three exact enabled plugs and destination

instructions: Never write posts or plugs yourself when Threadify generation is unavailable; report the exact blocker and manual next step.
When the read does not start on 1 January, say the real window instead of this year.
When the casing guard fails, present Threadify's original text unchanged.
When a number is not returned, show it as unknown, never 0.
When Auto Plug is not on the plan, say so and ask whether to schedule without plugs or stop.
When the host has no reminder or scheduler, give a dated note for the 7-day re-run.
Use supported native editable blocks with a real Done editing event; otherwise open the bundled loopback editor and wait for its command to finish.
Auto Plugs are off by default and optional; never call offer or plug tools after an explicit skip request.

must_prove: pattern labels and #1 pattern with examples
scheduled posts, slots and enabled Auto Plug echo or verified off state
original and final copy with editing mode and owner request
source review findings and destination review only when Auto Plugs are enabled
final post hashes, enabled plug hashes and exact approval revision
Done editing completion separate from scheduling approval
owner edit comparisons and task-specific wording observations
